title: Commanders vs Bengals 22–20: Walk-Off FG Stuns Burrow 😱 #shorts
description:
The Washington Commanders beat the Cincinnati Bengals 22–20 on Monday Night Football when Drew Stevens kicked a 26-yard field goal as time expired. With 39 seconds left and no timeouts, Jayden Daniels hit rookie Antonio Williams for 22 and 42 yards after Evan McPherson's 56-yard field goal had put Cincinnati ahead. Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards in defeat; the Bengals are 7-3.

title: Every English Club to Win the Champions League 🏆 #UCL #shorts
description:
Every English club that has won the European Cup or Champions League: Liverpool 6 (1977, 1978, 1981, 1984, 2005, 2019), Manchester United 3 (1968, 1999, 2008), Chelsea 2 (2012, 2021), Nottingham Forest 2 (1979, 1980), Aston Villa 1 (1982) and Manchester City 1 (2023). title: 4 NFL Teams Have Never Played in a Super Bowl 😳 #NFL #shorts
description:
Four NFL teams have never played in a Super Bowl: the Cleveland Browns, Detroit Lions, Houston Texans and Jacksonville Jaguars. The Browns and Lions both won NFL championships before the Super Bowl era, the Browns and Jaguars have each lost three AFC Championship Games, and the Texans have never gone beyond the divisional round since starting in 2002. The Lions are 8-2 this season and host the Bears on Thanksgiving.
